subject: general
question:
The pie-chart shows the distribution of the 5,00,040 employed people of a city according to their occupations in terms of the central angles of the sectors representing people engaged in the different occupations mentioned.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716af5d5f202c30cc90b9f051cfe5e25720835ce72bcbaefcbdb7bd34cfd9ef2.png] 

As per the information provided above, how many more people work in the service sector when compared to the number of people who engage themselves in business?
solution:
Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716af5d5f202c30cc90b9f051cfe5e25720835ce72bcbaefcbdb7bd34cfd9ef2.png] 

Total number of employees = 5,00,040

Calculation:

Total share for all sectors = 36 + 24 + 108 + 42 + 150 = 360

Degree for service sector = 42

Number of people working in the service sector = (42)/(360)times 500040 = 58,338

Degree for business sector = 24

Number of people working in the business sector = (24)/(360)times 500040 = 33,336

Difference in the number of people in both of these sectors = 58,338 – 33,336 = 25,002

Hence, there are 25,002 more people working in the service sector compared to the business sector.
